title: Gemini Gems Die October 20: Migrate Them Into Skills
kw_reason: The whole short is one handover: Gems die and Skills take their place. Skills is the replacement the viewer has to move to, so it is the word that carries the payoff, and at 6 characters it fits the terracotta line at full size.
hl_reason: Reads top to bottom as the video's claim in one sentence: Gemini Gems are being replaced by Skills. The dying product sits in the set-up, the replacement gets the highlight.
claim: Google is sunsetting Gemini Gems on October 20th and replacing them with Skills, so you should migrate your Gems.
quotes: Gemini Gems are being sunset on October 20th
they're being completely replaced by Skills
Don't forget to migrate your gems
reason: A product shutdown with a date and its replacement: the viewer promise is what changed and what to do about it, with no repeatable procedure shown.
yd:
Google is shutting down Gemini Gems on October 20th. Gems are being completely replaced by Skills, the new standard way to share your AI workflows, either with your teammates or with your community.

If you built Gems, migrate them into Skills before the cutoff.

Follow @migueltorrezai for daily AI news and tutorials.

#Gemini #GeminiGems #AINews
